bottleneck: Rough-010 again reached the PCS reply but its compiler exhausted the 32 GiB cap after about 186 seconds. Vector sum alone did not remove the large materialized public-weight arrays.
new_causal_evidence: Inspection of the exact generated public program found that each 16384-entry h0/h1/h2 weight vector has only 44 nonzero coefficients. All remaining coefficients are exact field zero. Their omitted products contribute exactly zero for every possible secret witness.
user_authorization: 2026-09-08 user requested completion through the full seven-party malicious-MPC and proof/tamper execution, after the preliminary blocked result.
causal_hypothesis: The explicit normalized fold consistently binds the complete masked financial sumcheck and linear-relation opening when all private scalar computations use the pinned malicious-shamir engine.
falsifiable_prediction: One fresh privately generated bounded financial witness produces a public proof accepted without private state; every declared negative case rejects.
single_intended_change: Emit the identical native dot product sparsely, omitting only public exactly-zero coefficients before creating compiler registers. No secret-dependent branching, codeword width, query count, relation, mask, -M or acceptance changes.

whole_candidate.private_relation: 64-row R1CS: private amount times price equals notional, notional plus private remainder equals reserve 65535, 8-bit amount and price and 16-bit remainder, and externally bound constant witness column
whole_candidate.native_mpc: Official pinned MP-SPDZ malicious-shamir, N=7, T=2, checked reveals; per-owner random input files and per-owner persistence loading; supported NO_MIXED_CIRCUITS build; compiler and runtime security remain 128; unavailable mixed-circuit instructions fail closed
whole_candidate.proof: Joint witness/mask commitment; padded first Spartan sumcheck; degree-three separable mask committed by coefficients; one general linear-functional opening for the second relation
explicit_adaptations: Normalized row fold (1-r)E+rO, without exceptional division at r=1
k=1 and native degree-two Shamir row dimension at points 1..7
One coPCS fold followed by a complete masked terminal oracle, with message width 16384 and RS evaluation width 65536
Degree-three separable Libra-style masking to match the full constraint sumcheck degree
One joint commitment and O(nnz) verifier linear-functional check instead of the optimized second sumcheck/sparse matrix oracle
Codeword domain is GENERATOR times the 65536-point subgroup; the fully revealed folded domain uses GENERATOR squared. Both are disjoint from the original secret-message interpolation subgroup.

Each private worker binds its statement and roots, recomputes Fiat-Shamir from the public constraint prefix and prior opening, releases each folded mask once, and checks/consumes one transcript-derived 512-query set.
whole_candidate.hash_and_queries: SHA-512 salted Merkle leaves and Fiat-Shamir; 512 per-opening queries; exact security parameter/composition proof is not claimed by this smoke

baseline: Existing classical/hybrid release is unchanged; this is not a performance comparison or a production promotion.
evaluation_population: One fresh distributed synthetic financial witness; proof mutations using the same accepted proof; actual native rejection runs for an invalid witness and two inconsistent party views.
likely_prediction_error: Predicted: honest full proof and all negatives pass with the unchanged 32 GiB cap; if not, the failure is downstream PCS binding or owner authorization, not a reason to shrink cryptographic parameters.
rejection_rule: Any invalid case accepted, missing expected native rejection marker, private coordinator witness reconstruction, wrong threshold, substituted classical proof, missing proof artifact or failed standalone verification prevents smoke success.
promotion_rule: At most smoke_only; production, security/composition review, operational financial commitment adapters, full lifecycle and independent operators remain outside this experiment's acceptance authority.

compiler_dependency.name: gmpy2
compiler_dependency.use: Pinned official compiler only; isolated target directory; no custom proof-core code

additional_security_gate: After all seven declared negatives, each of seven owner workers must reject a repeated query request with the exact consumed-budget error, not a crash or unrelated native failure.
